projects.title: AI-powered POS system
projects.description: Developed a full-stack AI-powered POS system with cashier checkout, inventory management, sales analytics, receipt generation, multi-payment support, role-based access control, and English/Sinhala support. Implemented real-time stock alerts using SSE, automated inventory updates with PostgreSQL transactions, and AI-powered business recommendations using Hugging Face and Gemini APIs.

projects.title: AI-powered Expense Manager
projects.description: Developed a full-stack expense management application with AI-powered spending insights and personalized financial recommendations. Implemented secure authentication, expense tracking, database management, and interactive financial data visualization using modern web technologies.

projects.title: AI-powered Sleep Tracker
projects.description: Developed a full-stack sleep tracking application with AI-powered sleep quality insights and personalized wellness recommendations. Implemented secure authentication, sleep cycle tracking, database management, and interactive sleep data visualization using modern web technologies.

projects.title: Open Source Contribution
projects.description: Implemented dynamic custom category management for the Add Resource module, including persistent categories, inline creation and deletion, validation, and an interactive category-tag UI.

projects.title: Car Showcase Web Application
projects.description: Developed a responsive car showcase application with search, filtering, pagination, and dynamic vehicle data. Integrated external APIs and built reusable, type-safe components using Next.js and TypeScript.

projects.title: IoT-based Artifact Monitoring System
projects.description: Developed an IoT-based monitoring system with real-time sensor data, web-based monitoring, database integration, and automated alerts. Contributed to Arduino/ESP8266 programming, device communication, I2C integration, and system integration.
